summary:
Summary of completed Referral A4 Print and PDF slip adjustments:
- Added built-in vector SVG of the National Emblem of Laos (Pha That Luang, rice stalks, cogwheel gear, reservoir, red ribbons).
- Centered Lao national motto block with ***==***.
- Subheader: Left side showing province and origin hospital; Right side showing REF ID, HN, phone, and triage level on the same line.
- Removed unwanted divider line below header.
- Cleaned insurance string to remove abbreviations like (NHI/ປສຊ).
- Inline diagnosis continuation directly in Section II header.
- Removed hardcoded/spurious oxygen device text.
- Inline initial treatment continuation directly in Section V.
- Redesigned signature section: Left "ຜູ້ອຳນວຍການ", Right "ທ່ານຫມໍສົ່ງຄົນເຈັບ", removed hospital names and underlines, leaving generous blank space for manual signing/stamping.
- Configured single-page A4 print layout avoiding page 2 overflow, with direct browser Print and Save-as-PDF support.
